rejected_rule.statement: A mortgage of lands does not include a mortgage of the usufructuary rights, and a subsequent mortgage bond does not transfer such rights to a third party unless properly executed for that purpose.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "I do not think so, at all events not so as to affect a third party who subsequently acquires that mortgage interest. The mortgage of January 29, 1912, is not a transfer of the lands, and hence not a transfer of the first defendant's right of possession of the lands"
